verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships AI features such as the AI code reviewer, AI-powered pipeline workflows and Rovo, so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence shows Bitbucket acting as an MCP client that can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. The official Atlassian MCP server (probe-4) is the server role, which is a different story, and the partner-tool integrations are an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit here.
